user_statement: est-ce qu'ils ne sont pas un peu trop détaillés les rendants un peu difficiles à lire ? Aussi, j'aimerais que les premiers monstres soient des humains normaux (des cultistes) parce qu'ils sont moins dangereux que les possédés / hybrides :)
accepted_design_direction: Simplifier les traits et textures pour lire les masses à taille native.
Les premières rencontres sont des cultistes humains ordinaires, moins dangereux dans la progression que les possédés et hybrides.
Réserver possédés et hybrides à des rencontres ultérieures, puis accentuer la descente démoniaque.

Static appearance review only.
Keep the hunched human possessed worker, petrol-blue vest, ochre trousers, respirator, normal left arm, two boots, and the right forearm converted into a short round-barrel firing organ. Simplify the firing organ to ONE dark barrel shape with ONE pale rim and one ochre collar, no repeated rings or plates. Keep only ONE broad hose loop from back to arm. Show corruption by one large exposed sinew patch at shoulder, not a web of muscles. Make vest mostly plain blue and trousers mostly plain ochre, at most one readable torn gap in each. records.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: ONE full-body enemy character source for a 64px native game tile in Project RL, a grim industrial cyberpunk roguelike.
Primary request: a completely NORMAL HUMAN CULTIST, one of the FIRST and comparatively least dangerous enemies. Intact human body and human face; no possession, no mutation, no grafts or superhuman muscles. These are ordinary adult civilians who joined the cult. Five-heads-tall compact adult proportions, no chibi, height equal to the human mission officer.
Input image: ONLY graphic-style and adult-scale reference. Do not copy the reference officer's uniform, helmet, diagonal belt or command stance.
Art style: very clean bold controlled black outlines, broad FLAT graphic-novel color regions, only ONE broad shadow per material, around 14-16 useful colors, no little scratches, rust, grain, shading gradients, polygon facets, dense cloth folds or excessive seams. Design to stay immediately recognizable at only 60 pixels body height. Two large clothing colors, simple light/shadow hierarchy. Mature serious cyberpunk setting, not fantasy medieval, not cute cartoon.
Faction clothing: repurposed civilian/work clothing in burgundy and slate-grey with one wide DIRTY-IVORY band wrapped around an upper arm. No diagonal chest sash, no chest armor, no big pauldrons, no heavy greaves, no glowing symbols, no magical effects or futuristic implants. Ordinary eyes with dark irises, normal intact skin in natural beige/brown/ochre tones (no pink palette), readable unmodified hands and face.
Framing: one complete standing nearly frontal human, slight overhead game view, entire head, held equipment and boots fully inside generous true alpha transparent margins. No floor, environment, shadow, text, names, lettering, alternate poses or other people. Static armed-pose REVIEW concept; separate runtime body/arm/weapon/finger layers are not yet authored.

Subject CULT-01: stocky adult male civilian cultist with short dark hair, a broad normal bare face and a tense angry frown, no beard large enough to obscure facial anatomy. Short burgundy sleeveless padded WORK VEST over plain slate-grey rolled sleeves, blue-grey work trousers, plain dark work boots. One broad ivory upper-arm band, otherwise minimal adornment. TWO normal hands and two normal legs. In his RIGHT gloved hand (viewer left) he holds ONE short thick blunt dark steel baton pointed diagonally down and out, its cylindrical grip clearly enclosed by fingers, with a small visible gap between baton and trouser leg. No sword blade, no spikes, no gigantic wrench. LEFT hand is empty, half-raised in a guarded tense posture. Grounded cautious stance with bent knees, far less imposing than an armored professional soldier. Hands, baton and face must read as ordinary human. Vest as one unbroken burgundy block, sleeves as one slate-grey block, trousers mostly plain with only one fold at each knee.

references.role: Adult scale and graphic style only
